title: Kenyan Doomsday Pastor Mackenzie Found Guilty Of Murdering 191 Followers, Deaths Celebrated As ‘Weddings’ With Jesus
desc: A Kenyan doomsday cult leader, Paul Mackenzie, has been found guilty of murdering 191 people, most of them children, after ordering his followers to starve themselves and their children to death to “meet Jesus”. Twenty-nine other leaders of the cult were also convicted of murder. They had pleaded not guilty, insisting that nobody was forced to die. Delivering an eight-hour judgment, Justice Diana Mochache said Mackenzie’s followers believed he was “Jesus’s mouthpiece”.
